## Changes

### Smoother
- Scrolling no longer stalls while you read, refresh or come back to the app. Saving your page, refreshing bookmarks, opening a comic and syncing used to reload the whole library each time; now they update only what changed, and sync works in the background.
- Saving your reading position no longer syncs after every page; it syncs once when you leave the chapter or the app.
- Bookmark refresh checks up to 3 comics at once (one per source) and only downloads a comic's details when it has new chapters.
- Hidden pages used for sites like WestManga and ReiManga are smaller, pause between uses and close sooner.
- The app opens faster: the splash takes 2 seconds and tabs load when you first open them.

### Fixes
- A chapter without pages shows an error instead of a grey screen.
- Keep screen on stays on after moving to the next chapter.
- Moving quickly to the next chapter no longer makes Continue reading point back at the previous one.
- Opening a one-page chapter no longer marks it read straight away.
- Restoring a backup or importing after deleting comics no longer gets undone by sync.
- Sync no longer gets stuck on "Syncing", and a full Drive or a rate limit no longer signs you out.
- A refresh no longer brings back a comic you deleted or migrated.
- Migrate and Import wait until the search finishes; imported progress moves with a migrated comic.
- Extension settings with long keys no longer corrupt extension storage.
